name: expense-api

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends the household invite email when one partner invites the other.

description: Owns the household, its expenses, categories, budgets and spending reports. Creates and pairs households, logs and edits shared expenses, manages the category list and per-category monthly budgets, and serves category/trend/paid-by reports against fixed periods. Does not send email itself (delegates to the email-service dependency) and does not suggest expense categories (the categorizer-agent does, calling back into this API's category list).
